sql: select :platform::text not in ('instagram', 'facebook') or exists (select 1 from brandbase.brands b join brandbase.make_orgs o on o.org_id = b.org_id where b.id = :brand and b.org_id = any (brandbase.managed_orgs())) as ok
message: only the owners and admins of a company on the operator's list link Instagram and Facebook
